verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime's own docs describe a free Developer Sandbox with its own API keys, where developers can test the API without interfering with production data. A dedicated 'testing in sandbox' guide covers testing before going live, via command line or a Postman Collection. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of how closely the sandbox matches production (e.g., simulated transfer/settlement behavior, data reset).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: safely test the API without worrying about interfering with production data
Before going live you should get familiar with our APIs and test your integration in sandbox
you can do your testing as in command line or using our Postman Collection to speed up your initial exploration of our APIs
